ET-STUDY-001.title: Verify first-time video watch at 1x is tracked
ET-STUDY-001.reference_steps: Open app > Home > Foundation > Maths Foundation > Topic > Subtopic/Concept > Play a 10-min video at 1x for the full duration
ET-STUDY-001.reference_expected: 10 minutes is added to Study Time based on screen time.

ET-STUDY-002.title: Verify 1.25x playback calculation
ET-STUDY-002.reference_steps: Play a 10-min Subtopic/Concept video at 1.25x for the full video

ET-STUDY-003.title: Verify 1.5x playback calculation
ET-STUDY-003.reference_steps: Play a 10-min video at 1.5x for the full video

ET-STUDY-004.title: Verify 1.75x playback calculation
ET-STUDY-004.reference_steps: Play a 10-min video at 1.75x for the full video

ET-STUDY-005.title: Verify 2x playback calculation
ET-STUDY-005.reference_steps: Play a 10-min video at 2x for the full video

ET-STUDY-006.title: Verify partial watch is based on screen time
ET-STUDY-006.reference_steps: Watch a portion of a Subtopic/Concept video and stop
ET-STUDY-006.reference_expected: Only qualifying screen time is added; unwatched duration is not added.

ET-STUDY-007.title: Verify seek-forward behavior
ET-STUDY-007.reference_steps: Play video, seek forward, and continue watching
ET-STUDY-007.reference_expected: Only actual qualifying screen time is counted; skipped duration is not counted.

ET-STUDY-008.title: Verify seek-backward behavior
ET-STUDY-008.reference_steps: Play video, seek backward, and continue watching
ET-STUDY-008.reference_expected: Only actual qualifying screen time is counted; replayed screen time is counted according to the playback rule.

ET-STUDY-009.title: Verify repeated viewing behavior
ET-STUDY-009.reference_steps: Watch the same Subtopic/Concept video again after completing it
ET-STUDY-009.reference_expected: Verify the configured repeat-watch rule and that effort is not incorrectly duplicated beyond the requirement.

ET-STUDY-010.title: Verify Review Mode is excluded
ET-STUDY-010.reference_steps: Open a completed video in Review Mode and watch for several minutes
ET-STUDY-010.reference_expected: No Study Time is added from Review Mode.

ET-STUDY-011.title: Verify downloaded video behavior
ET-STUDY-011.reference_steps: Download an eligible Subtopic/Concept video, open it from Downloads, and watch
ET-STUDY-011.reference_expected: Verify whether downloaded-video watch time is tracked; record behavior against the product requirement.

ET-STUDY-012.title: Verify Resource video is excluded
ET-STUDY-012.reference_steps: Open a Resource video and watch for several minutes
ET-STUDY-012.reference_expected: No Study Time should be added because Resource video effort is excluded.

ET-STUDY-013.title: Verify private live video/session is excluded
ET-STUDY-013.reference_steps: Open a private live video/session and observe effort before/after attendance
ET-STUDY-013.reference_expected: No Study Time should be added for private live video/session unless a separate attendance-effort rule exists.

ET-STUDY-014.title: Verify public live video/session is excluded
ET-STUDY-014.reference_steps: Open a public live video/session and watch for several minutes
ET-STUDY-014.reference_expected: No Study Time should be added for public live video/session.

ET-STUDY-018.title: Verify review time is excluded

ET-STUDY-020.title: Verify 5-minute cap on problem-based quiz question

ET-STUDY-021.title: Verify problem-based quiz review exclusion
ET-STUDY-021.reference_steps: Submit problem-based quiz and review questions
ET-STUDY-021.reference_expected: Review time does not add to Study Time.

ET-STUDY-031.title: Verify My Notes writing tracking

ET-REV-002.title: Verify revision PDF behavior

ET-REV-003.reference_expected: Verify whether revision-live attendance is tracked according to the approved requirement.
